subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Letter-sound relationships of most single letters

show.line: More sounds! c, c, cat. k, k, kite. e, e, egg. u, u, umbrella.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with k, as in kite?
Say the sound with me. u, as in umbrella!
Which word has e in the middle? Listen. Pen, pin.
Which one starts with c, as in cat?
Which word has u in the middle? Listen. Bus, bat.
Trace e with your finger. Across, then up and round.
Does it start with c or k? Sort the pictures.

hints: c and k make the same sound. Look at the letter shape.
e and u are vowels. Listen in the middle of the word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the vowel in bus.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The vowel in bus is e!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! b, u, s. The vowel is u.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it slowly. Buuus. The middle sound is u!

parent_line: Can hear and recognise the sounds c, k, e and u.
